title: Yunikorn k8shim: Historically, we have been rather lax about malformed framing-related headers in our HTTP/2…
description: A security vulnerability in the yunikorn-k8shim package prior to version 1.9.0-r1 involves lax handling of malformed framing-related headers in its HTTP/2 implementation. Although these malformed headers cannot disrupt HTTP/2 framing, they can lead to a high-impact integrity issue. The vulnerability is rated with a CVSS score of 7.5 (high severity).
